{{Quote|Our people have seen that the Sith are vulnerable whenever we stand united. This war will be dark and brutal and vicious. But we will stand against that darkness together. And together, we will win.|[[Ardinondu Dipolus Daeruun]]|<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" />}}
The '''Third Galactic War'''<ref name="ManaanCodex">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Manaan Visitor's Center: Exploration Dome}}</ref> was a conflict which broke out across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and the [[Eternal Alliance]] and many third parties, like the [[Hidden Chain]].

==Origins==
During the second [[Galactic War]], both the Empire and Republic were unexpectedly [[Eternal Empire raids|attacked]] by the mysterious [[Eternal Empire]] from [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. A temporary fragile alliance between the two superpowers was subsequently created, represented by [[Dark Council]] member [[Darth Marr]] and the Republic war hero who would become known as the [[Alliance Commander|Outlander]]. During a search for the former [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] in Wild Space, [[Darth Marr's flagship]] was suddenly [[Destruction of Darth Marr's flagship|ambushed]] by the Eternal Empire's [[Eternal Fleet]], and both Marr and the Outlander were captured and taken to the capital [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Zakuul]], where Marr was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] and the Outlander was imprisoned in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]].<ref name="KOTFE 1">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=1}}</ref> 


After [[Assassin/Legends|assassinating]] his father, the new Emperor [[Arcann]] launched a full scale [[Eternal Empire conquest|invasion]] of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], conquering the Empire and the Republic and turning them into puppet states to Zakuul.<ref name="KOTFE 2">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=2}}</ref> Many years after the conquest, the [[Eternal Empire]] was [[War against Zakuul|overthrown]] by the Outlander&mdash;who was then known as the Alliance Commander&mdash;[[Battle of Zakuul|taking]] Zakuul in the name of the new [[Eternal Alliance]].<ref name="KOTET 9">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=9}}</ref> After a pyrrhic victory in [[Mission to Nathema (Zildrog)|wiping out]] the [[Order of Zildrog|last]] of the Eternal Empire's followers, the Commander decided to work more closely with the Galactic Republic.<ref name="Nathema" />

==History==
===Jedi Under Siege===
{{Main|Invasion of Ossus}}
In [[3628 BBY]],<ref name="UnderSiege-Date" /> the Sith Empire discovered that [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]], long thought [[Death/Legends|dead]], was hiding in a secret [[Jedi Colony]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. [[Sith Emperor/Legends|Sith Emperor]] [[Darth Vowrawn]] promptly ordered an [[Invasion of Ossus|invasion]] of the planet, under the command of [[Darth Malgus]] and Dark Council member [[Darth Malora]], starting the third Galactic War.<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" />

===Dantooine Incursion===
{{Main|Dantooine Incursion}}
The Sith Empire [[Dantooine Incursion|targeted]] the planet [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. Unable to defeat its defenses, the Sith worked with the [[Nova Blades]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. Imperial [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Lenora Trazen]] led operations to destabilize the planet.<ref name="Dantooine Tactical Report">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20190503|text=Dantooine Tactical Report|int=Dantooine Tactical Report}}</ref> The Nova Blades' surprise assault caught the Republic off-guard, but as the pirates began plundering, they turned on the Empire.<ref name="Pirate Incursion">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20190514|text=New In-Game Event - The Pirate Incursion}}</ref> Eventually, [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] of the Eternal Alliance arrived to aid the Republic in defending the planet.<ref name="Marauders">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=event|The Marauders of Dantooine}}</ref>

===Conflict on Onderon===
{{Main|Mission to Onderon (3627 BBY)}}
In [[3627 BBY]],<ref name="Onslaught-Date">{{TOR_updates|6.0}}</ref> [[King/Legends|King]] [[Regalun Petryph]] sought to exploit [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] resources for personal gain, clashing with [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Deja Nebet]] and her council of nobles. Petryph unknowingly fell under the influence of [[Darth Savik]]. Savik, aiming to seize control of Onderon's resources, manipulated Petryph into starting a civil war by convincing him that Nebet and the nobles were plotting against him.<ref name="Palace Intrigue">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=faction|Republic|Palace Intrigue|[[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]}}</ref>

===Fuel crisis===
{{Main|Mission to Mek-Sha}}
A Republic fleet led by [[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]] [[Dol Narlock]], docked on [[Mek-Sha]] for refueling en route to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Meanwhile, [[Darth Shaar]] planned to destroy the fleet to weaken [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]'s defense. Mek-Sha's independence, built on a fuel failsafe by the station's queen, [[Huttbreaker]], became central to the Empire's plan to destroy the Republic ships. The decision to allow the Republic to refuel hinged on a vote by Mek-Sha's crews, with Republic sympathizer [[Junker Jott]] and Huttbreaker supporting the fleet.<ref name="Gangs of Mek-Sha">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=faction|Republic|The Gangs of Mek-Sha|[[Mek-Sha]]}}</ref>

===Meridian Complex assault===
{{Quote|Let the battle begin.|Darth Malgus|<ref name="Objective: Meridian">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=flashpoint|Objective: Meridian}}</ref>}}
{{Main|Battle of the Meridian Complex}}
[[File:BattleofCorellia3627BBY.png|thumb|right|240px|Tau Idair duels Darth Malgus on Corellia.]]
Not long after the [[Mission to Mek-Sha|mission]] on Mek-Sha, the Sith Empire, led by Darth Malgus, launched a multi-fleet [[Battle of the Meridian Complex|assault]] on the Republic, with one fleet attacking the Republic fleet and another bombarding the planet's surface to distract them. Meanwhile, Malgus led a ground assault on the [[Meridian Complex]]. The Alliance Commander, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Tau Idair]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Arn Peralun]], pursued Malgus, confronting him and restoring the complex's defenses. Malgus retreated and Krovos' fleet was forced to withdraw.<ref name="Objective: Meridian" />

===Uncovering secrets===
{{Quote|I have done something no other Sith could achieve&mdash;I've broken my chains. No one can stop me. Not the Republic, not the Empire&hellip;, not you.|Darth Malgus, to Aryn Leneer|<ref name="Secrets">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=flashpoint|Secrets of the Enclave}}</ref>}}
In [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="Enclave-Date">{{TOR_updates|6.3}}</ref> Darth Malgus, tormented by visions of his defeat and capture by Emperor Vowrawn and [[Darth Krovos]], Malgus sought a way to remove the effects plaguing him. Upon arriving at the [[Jedi Enclave]] ruins on Dantooine, Malgus ventured deeper into the ruins where he discovered an ancient relic belonging to [[Darth Nul]], an ancient [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] whose records had been erased from history. The Jedi were soon dispatched to the Enclave to investigate the ruins.<ref name="Secrets" />

===Threats from within===
{{Quote|I have seen a vision of the future. A galaxy in flames. What I have begun will not end with me. This is only the beginning.|Darth Malgus|<ref name="Ruins of Nul">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=flashpoint|Ruins of Nul}}</ref>}}
{{Main|Invasion of Manaan|Mission to Elom}}
Around [[3625 BBY]],<ref name="LotS-Date">{{TOR_updates|7.0}}</ref> The Sith Empire invaded the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] planet [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] to seize its mass-produced and valuable [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]] to turn the tide of the war in their favor while fending off Republic forces supporting the [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] to thwart the Empire's plans.<ref name="Dead in the Water">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=faction|Republic|Dead in the Water|Manaan}}</ref> Meanwhile, the rogue Sith Lord Darth Malgus traveled to the [[Temple of Nul]] on the planet [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]]. At the same time, the Jedi had discovered the mystery surrounding Darth Nul and uncovered a connection between the planet Elom and Nul, believing it to be a place where Malgus sought answers. Jedi Master [[Denolm Orr]] then assembled a team, including his Padawan [[Sa'har Kateen]], to [[Mission to Elom|investigate]] Elom.<ref name="Mission Abstract">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20211001-0|text=Mission Abstract: Investigate link between Darth Malgus and the planet Elom|int=Mission Abstract: Investigate link between Darth Malgus and the planet Elom}}</ref>

[[File:MalgusVsOrr-Disorder.jpg|thumb|left|270px|Malgus battles Denolm Orr on the Temple of Nul.]]
During the mission, Denolm Orr's team encountered Imperial forces on Elom, leaving only him and his Padawan alive to reach the temple.<ref name="Mission Abstract" /> They discovered a mysterious machine powered by a [[Darth Nul's holocron|holocron]]. Orr and Kateen soon found themselves facing a [[Unidentified Sith warrior (Elom)|Sith warrior]]. As they confronted the Sith warrior, the Sith was unexpectedly killed by Malgus who had just entered the temple. While Malgus and Orr dueled, Sa'har interacted with the machine, leading her to a vision of her past. After Orr destroyed the machine, Sa'har retrieved the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] but refused to hand it over, leading to a confrontation between them. Malgus took an opportunity, killing Orr and leaving Sa'har buried under rubble while taking the holocron.<ref name="Disorder">{{TORYouTube|QgbMAdtp7aE|STAR WARS™: The Old Republic™ - 'Disorder' Cinematic Trailer}}</ref>

Malgus later encountered the Alliance Commander, Tau Idair, and [[Lana Beniko]] who had just arrived on Elom and was defeated. He was later [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] aboard [[Carrick Station]]. Meanwhile, Sa'har survived the temple's destruction, found the holocron hidden by Malgus and left the planet.<ref name="Ruins of Nul" />

===Heta Kol's plans===
{{Main|Hidden Chain raids|Malgus's escape}}
During the [[Mandalorian civil war (Third Galactic War)|Mandalorian civil war]] between [[Mandalorian Trat'ade|Mandalore the Avenger's faction]] and the [[Hidden Chain]] splinter faction, [[Field Marshal/Legends|Field Marshal]] [[Heta Kol]] of the Hidden Chain sought to use Darth Nul's holocron to create an army of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]].<ref name="Defiance" /> Around [[3623 BBY]],<ref name="Desperate-Date">{{TOR_updates|7.5}}</ref> The Alliance Commander and Sa'har Kateen [[Mission to Hidden Chain Ship|infiltrated]] their [[Hidden Chain flagship|flagship]] to stop Heta Kol. After defeating Sa'har's brother, [[Ri'kan Kateen|Ri'kan]], and sabotaging the [[Holocron Machine]], the Commander attempted to help the siblings but the path was blocked by falling debris forcing the Commander to escape the flagship with the holocron.<ref name="Sundering1">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Sundering|the [[Hidden Chain flagship]]}}</ref> Meanwhile, Shae Vizla and her mercenaries [[Malgus's escape|broke]] Malgus out of Carrick Station, fearing that Heta Kol's war would provoke both the Galactic Republic and Sith Empire. To prevent the destruction of all [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], Vizla aligned herself with Malgus, the only one capable of stopping Heta Kol.<ref name="Sundering2">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Sundering|[[Carrick Station]]}}</ref>

===Malgus' plans===
The Eternal Alliance set out to track down Darth Malgus after his release and stop his dangerous plans while searching for answers about Darth Nul's holocron and uncover the true intentions of the Hidden Chain.<ref name="GalacticThreads-Live">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20241114-0|text=Game Update 7.6 "Galactic Threads" Recap}}</ref>
